<thought>We have the CIF content of the chosen slab. Use the get_adsorption_sites_text tool to identify adsorption sites, then write the returned JSON to a file and provide its path.</thought>
<action>get_adsorption_sites_text</action>
<action_input>{
    "slab_cif": "data_Si
_symmetry_space_group_name_H-M   'F d -3 m'
_cell_length_a   5.431
_cell_length_b   5.431
_cell_length_c   5.431
_cell_angle_alpha   90
_cell_angle_beta    90
_cell_angle_gamma   90
_symmetry_Int_Tables_number   227
_chemical_formula_structural Si
_chemical_formula_sum 'Si1'
loop_
 _atom_site_label
 _atom_site_type_symbol
 _atom_site_fract_x
 _atom_site_fract_y
 _atom_site_fract_z
 Si1 Si 0 0 0
"
}
